title: NeuroSync-MoE: Hierarchical Spectral-Spatial Mixture-of-Experts with Diffusion-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Alcoholism Detection
description: Open-source deep learning framework and empirical evaluation suite for NeuroSync-MoE. Features: (1) Differentiable Multi-Scale Spectral Tokenizer decomposing multi-channel EEG into canonical bands (delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma); (2) Two-Level Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HiMoE) with 5 Spectral Specialists, Cross-Expert Multi-Head Attention, and 4 Spatial Specialists; (3) Dual-Branch Spectral-Spatial Contrastive Self-Supervised Pretraining (SS-CSP); (4) Backpropagation-free Latent Diffusion Test-Time Adaptation (DG-TTA); and (5) Subject-Adversarial Domain Generalization (DANN/GRL) setting a leak-free state-of-the-art benchmark of 64.68% holdout accuracy across 40,290 evaluated epochs and 190 human subjects across SUNY Downstate UCI, OpenNeuro ds008851, and OpenNeuro ds005907 cohorts.
